## The loop, and consumables

9 components outside the cube. 2 consumables, at
6615 mm^3 of fluid a year against a 5e+04 mm^3 reservoir.

## Where the cost is

| | |
|---|---|
| silicon, at known-good prices | 0.7672 |
| yield | 0.08428 |
| assembly | 0.1485 |

**Memory tiers are two thirds of the silicon bill** — a tier is large enough that
only 0.6428 of them come off a wafer good. Assembly yield is
0.901, which is better than the bare arithmetic threatens because of the
four mitigations in `083`.

**Making the tiers smaller would save more than any assembly improvement**, and
nothing in the design has been asked whether a tier has to be one piece.

*No price is given. There is no volume, no supplier and no year, so a number
would be fiction. What survives is the structure.*
